content.short: Neon is a Brazilian digital bank for consumers and micro-entrepreneurs, with accounts, cards, Pix and credit.
content.description: Neon is a Brazilian digital bank serving consumers and individual micro-entrepreneurs, known as MEIs, who want simple, low-fee banking through their phones. Its app offers free digital accounts, debit and credit cards, Pix instant payments, savings and investment products, personal and payroll-backed loans, and features tailored to self-employed workers such as invoicing and business accounts. Neon targets working-class and underbanked Brazilians who have historically paid high fees at traditional banks, focusing on financial inclusion and credit access. By combining everyday accounts, cards, Pix and credit with tools for MEIs, it has grown into one of Brazil's notable challenger banks.
